milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate toward the smooth quartz slab path (nearest slab at spawn-relative ~4,0,3, approximately 5 blocks from spawn) and face it. Target is set to the middle of the quartz path at ~6,0,5 with max_distance=5 so the player must walk toward it, and facing_tolerance=60 to confirm they are looking at the slabs.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The note block is at spawn-relative ~9,0,7 with a torch on top as a visual marker. The player must navigate to within 5 blocks and face toward it, confirming they have located the note block at the end of the quartz path.

Uses inventory_has because mining a dark oak slab drops the dark_oak_slab item into the player's inventory. The player starts with no dark_oak_slab, so having at least 1 confirms successful mining. This is preferred over mine_block events since the item definitively ends up in inventory.

Uses inventory_has because crafting an oak_button (1 oak plank → 1 oak button at crafting table) places the item in the player's inventory. The player starts with no oak_button, so having at least 1 confirms successful crafting.
